"use client"

import * as AspectRatioPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-aspect-ratio"

/*
 * Bevel AspectRatio. The primitive holds a box at a ratio and paints
 * nothing, so it carries no styling of its own. Give the child the radius and
 * the shadow the surface needs.
 */

const AspectRatio = AspectRatioPrimitive.Root

export { AspectRatio }
